status: approved design intent and prepared source artwork; no application integration

buttons.purpose: Clickable interaction and utility controls, visually distinct from flat status readouts
composition: separate runtime icon, label and optional submenu chevron
buttons.resizing: Preserve rounded ends/corners and border thickness. Export aligned state canvases and shared caps; stretch only the quiet middle region. Whole-image nonuniform stretching is not the intended integration.
buttons.content: No text or icon baked into source. Disabled appearance does not implement action admission.
buttons.geometry_status: Generator source geometry is measured in provenance.json. Shared runtime crop/caps/content insets still require an export/actual-size review.
buttons.persistent_selection: Active follows authoritative toggle/selection, e.g. Offen halten. Keep a separate pin/label state cue; pressed is momentary. Disabled suppresses enabled hover/press feedback. Preserve selection during hover/press; combined variants need export review.

status_bar.purpose: Passive continuous numeric readout; not a clickable action control

layer_order.role: UI-rendered fill; width follows normalized value, entire filled part has current semantic color
thin rim with transparent broad interior; never bake opaque blue or white over the fill
separate readable label/value if displayed on the bar

status_bar.color_behavior: As the value decreases, the whole fill transitions continuously green -> yellow -> orange -> red. It is not a fixed horizontal rainbow.
status_bar.anchor_status: Provisional presentation interpolation anchors, not game-balance thresholds, health rules or new domain constants.

friendship.behavior: fixed blue fill; low relationship progress is not a critical-needs warning

status_bar.rendering: Clip fill to the actual inner rounded slot; never cover or stretch the frame by value. At zero show the track only, at full value fill the complete inner slot. Preserve full source alpha for compositing; do not apply the character sprite binary-alpha policy.
status_bar.accessibility: Keep numerical/text readouts so state is not communicated by red/green alone.
status_bar.geometry_status: Track and overlay are matching source candidates; export must align their measured rims and inner slot on the same runtime canvas.

source_policy.rejected_draft_storage: external local reference bundle only; hashes/prompts retained in versioned provenance

panels.appearance: Opaque near-white blush interior, delicate powder-blue border, transparent exterior; passive rather than raised action control
panels.composition: Separate content, separators, padding, optional local shadow and placement-dependent tooltip pointer; keep pure-white title bar
panels.resizing: Preserve border and corners via later nine-slice export; choose shared content insets at actual size
panels.tooltips: Fit within screen bounds, avoid obscuring the explained interaction, support keyboard access; no separate native submenu window

focus.appearance: Independent visible blue-gray outline; provisional 2 px with small gap
focus.behavior: Orthogonal to hover, press and active; retain visible keyboard focus

scrollbars.appearance: Near-white rose track, visible blue-gray thumb, clearer hover/drag
scrollbars.input: Wheel, keyboard and thumb dragging; preserve reachability of long content

transitions.constraints: No input delay or geometry jump; no bounce, continuous glow or pulsing bars; reduced motion uses immediate changes; instant fallback where fading is unsupported
transitions.status: Provisional visual tuning intent, native Windows/Tk feasibility pending; no animation-frame asset set

ui_rendered_effects.global_dimming_overlay: Not needed for agreed embedded menu flows
